The last UCITS ex-date (12 Nov) is before the window, and the JEGA ASX distribution revision (verified, 30.8092 cpu, about 0.6% of the unit price) applies to a different fund. Richer US implied volatility at the 20 Nov roll (VIX 35.89, verified) is a possible tailwind for December income, but no UCITS issuer notice confirms it. Held at 0; confidence capped at low (pillar unsaturated).
group_scores.falsifier: A JPM AM UCITS notice dated 14-20 Nov changing the overlay, ELN coupon or fee, or an NAV-vs-price gap above 1% on 20 or 23 Nov.

group_scores.rationale: The 20 Nov roll was struck with VIX 35.89 and VIX/VIX3M about 1.16 (both verified against Cboe). That means richer call premiums, which support JEPI December income, but the overlay caps the upside in a snapback. The 23 Nov rebound (post-window, S&P about +4.4%) shows that risk. The two effects offset. There is only one independent in-window source (Cboe); the CNBC/FRED corroboration could not be confirmed (403/bot wall), and no 19a-1 or structural check was run. Score 0, low.
group_scores.falsifier: High volatility persisting with a falling S&P through December (+1), or a sharp late-Nov/Dec rally that JEPI lags (-1). A 19a-1 or closure notice in the window would also change it.

group_scores.rationale: VXN was 45.25 at the 20 Nov roll, against 27.13 in October (verified), so QYLD/JEPQ premiums and coupons should be well above October's. Nvidia, the top NDX weight, reported a strong quarter (verified) but went through a CEO resign-and-reinstate episode, which adds two-way volatility. QYLD's at-the-money calls give up most of a rebound, and the 23 Nov Nasdaq +6.1% move (post-window, unconfirmed CNBC) is exactly that risk. JEPQ's November payout fell for a third month (T3, pre-window). The direction is unclear and there is no issuer distribution data in the window. Score 0, low.
group_scores.falsifier: December distributions sharply higher while the NDX is flat or lower (+1), or the NDX rebounds more than 5% within weeks of the 23 Nov reinstatement and QYLD/JEPQ lag (-1).
